kai: Quick note from the onboarding run for iris-30b-int8-delta: we see a subtle entropy increase and token reorder after ~7.2k tokens when using delta-KV snapshot + fast-pack path.

zoe: can you outline repro?

kai: repro below:
```
MODEL=iris-30b:int8-delta
python -m tools.long_onboard \
  --model $MODEL \
  --prompt tests/7k_mixed_tech.txt \
  --prime-len 7200 \
  --gen-len 800 \
  --kv-delta true \
  --snapshot-interval 1200 \
  --seed 11
```
Artifacts: s3://redwood-debug/iris-30b/delta-1765559999/

pat: what's the failure mode?

kai: not a crash; small-scale token swaps (commas->periods, arg ordering in short code). We compute per-token divergence and see a step change near snapshot 6.

zoe: any packing logs?

kai: yes snippet:
```
[INFO] kvdelta: snapshot_idx=6 tiles_written=987 expected=988
[WARN] fastpack: partial_byte_unfilled=1
[DEBUG] layer=16 v_max_abs_diff=9.2e-04
```

pat: partial_byte_unfilled=1 again. we've seen this but usually in int4 rollouts.

zoe: hypothesis: the delta writer's fast-pack assumes aligned tile strides but delta size can be non-multiple of pack_gran. When snapshotting into a delta buffer we miss zeroing last pad byte which later gets interpreted during replay and mutates V slightly.

kai: agreed. plan: 1) re-run with --fastpack-pad=1 (explicit pad) and --snapshot-verify=true to assert tile counts. 2) replay snapshots into clean runtime and compare per-layer K/V with tol=1e-6. 3) if repro holds, add a lightweight zero-fill on delta writes.

ci-bot: ci job queued for branch "delta-pack-guard" build 2026.03.22.09

pat: also try running with delta disabled to isolate whether it's the delta encoding or the fast-pack logic.

kai: started three quick runs: (a) fastpack with pad, (b) fastpack fallback software, (c) delta disabled. Early 10m results: (a) no warnings and outputs match fp32 up to 9k; (b) matches fp32 fully; (c) matches. So fastpack pad fix seems effective.

zoe: good. can we add a unit test that constructs a non-aligned delta size and asserts snapshot roundtrip equality?

kai: will add test and a metric fastpack.pad_applied_count. Also opening PR draft with zero-fill guard and the unit test.

pat: once PR merges, schedule a 24h canary with iris-30b:int8-delta on two low-latency shards and query the pad metric. If we see pad_applied_count>0 in stable traffic, we may need a migration.

kai: noted. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4120 (WIP). Uploading artifacts and comparisons to s3://redwood-debug/iris-delta-pad/1765559999/

zoe: thanks. this was subtle but high-impact for long-context code tests. tagging @eng-ml for visibility.
